collections.description:
Multiple competencies can be associated with the same question
Competencies are used to show the User result as a breakdown in their test results.
e.g. 10 questions, 5 tagged as Airport, 5 tagged as Airline. You get 3 from airport correct and 2 from airline correct.
The result will not show as 5 out 10 points achieved but will show
You got 60% Airport and 40% Airline

There's also the concept of the test player which are the configurations of the exam.

One test player can be assigned to one or many Exams but one Exam can have one or none test player(manually configured)

This enables us to preconfigure some of the exam settings:
e.g. Time Limit, Display/Not Display Answers, Detailed View, Test Display horizontally or veritcally

AWS Athena restricted SQL functionality:

select
        com.component_id as "cd_course_id",   
        des.metatag_id as "cd_metatag_id", 
        com.object_id as "cd_course_object_id",
	com.major_version as "cd_course_major_version_number",
        com.version as "cd_course_version_number", 
        com.name as "de_course_name",  
	com.external_migration_id as "cd_yardstick_session_number",
        lfd.name as "de_delivery_method",
        langd.language_name as "de_language",
	CASE when corinactive.component_id is not null then 'InActive'
		 when corinactive.component_id is null then 'Active' end as "de_cancellation_status",
	des.content as "de_course_attribute_value" ,  COALESCE(Courskill.skill_id,'0') as "cd_skill_id",
	template.object_id as "cd_template_object_id", 
        com.lastupdater_id as "cd_last_updator_id",
        locs.node_id as "cd_venue_id",
	com.description as "de_course_description",  comt.publisher_id as "cd_publisher_id",
	comt.publishingdate as "dt_publishing_date",  MemberPrice.currency_value as "nb_member_price_value" ,
	ATCPrice.currency_value as "nb_atc_price_value" , ATCDNAPrice.currency_value as "nb_atc_dna_price_value",
	DevNatPrice.currency_value as "nb_dna_price_value", com.lastupdated as "dt_last_update_date",
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc", NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
from (select * from ods_imc_e_component where is_template = '0' and archive = '0') com      --not a template
join (select * from ods_imc_e_componenttype where characteristic_id = '4' ) comt on com.type_id = comt.componenttype_id   --this is now going to get courses
left join ods_imc_e_component template on  com.template_id = template.component_id   -- this is the main template not the version
left join (select metatag_id, component_id,content from ods_imc_e_description) des on com.component_id  = des.component_id
left join ods_imc_content_language conlang on com.component_id = conlang.content_id
left join ods_imc_languagedefinition langd  on conlang.default_language_id = langd.language_id
left join (select name, course_maintype_id from ods_imc_course_maintype_d  where language_id = '26') cormtd on comt.master_id = cormtd.course_maintype_id
join  (select *  from ods_imc_course_maintype ) cormt on cormtd.course_maintype_id = cormt.course_maintype_id
join  (select * from  ods_imc_learningform_d where language_id = '26')  lfd on cormt.learningform_id = lfd.learningform_id 
left join (select price.component_id, priceplgrp.group_name, price.currency_code, price.currency_value  from ods_imc_price_currency_composing price
			join (select group_id, group_name from ods_imc_platformgroup_d where language_id = '26') priceplgrp on price.group_id = priceplgrp.group_id
			where price.group_id in ('113317'))  MemberPrice on com.component_id = MemberPrice.component_id
left join (select price.component_id, priceplgrp.group_name, price.currency_code, price.currency_value  from ods_imc_price_currency_composing price
			join (select group_id, group_name from ods_imc_platformgroup_d where language_id = '26') priceplgrp on price.group_id = priceplgrp.group_id
			where price.group_id in ('113318'))  DevNatPrice on com.component_id = DevNatPrice.component_id
left join (select price.component_id, priceplgrp.group_name, price.currency_code, price.currency_value  from ods_imc_price_currency_composing price
			join (select group_id, group_name from ods_imc_platformgroup_d where language_id = '26') priceplgrp on price.group_id = priceplgrp.group_id
			where price.group_id in ('158154'))  ATCPrice on com.component_id = ATCPrice.component_id
left join (select price.component_id as "cd_group_id", priceplgrp.group_name, price.currency_code, price.currency_value  from ods_imc_price_currency_composing  price
			join (select group_id, group_name from ods_imc_platformgroup_d where language_id = '26') priceplgrp on price.group_id = priceplgrp.group_id
			where price.group_id in ('158155')    )  ATCDNAPrice on com.component_id = ATCDNAPrice.cd_group_id
left join (select * from ods_imc_r_location_structure) locs on com.location_id = locs.node_id 
left join (select * from ods_imc_r_location_structure_d where language_id='26' )  locd on locd.node_id = locs.node_id
left join (select DISTINCT OBJECT_ID as "cd_course_id" ,skill_id from ods_imc_skill_value where objecttype_id = '3' and is_scheduled = '1')	Courskill on com.component_id = Courskill.cd_course_id	-- join gets the skill associated with this course	
/* join against a row for the same component */
left join (	select DISTINCT
			com.component_id
			from (	select * from ods_imc_e_component where is_template = '0' and archive = '0') com
					join (select * from ods_imc_e_componenttype where characteristic_id = '4' )  comt on com.type_id = comt.componenttype_id  -- courses
					left join ods_imc_e_description des on com.component_id  = des.component_id 
                                        left join ods_imc_content_language conlang on com.component_id = conlang.content_id
                                        left join ods_imc_languagedefinition langd  on conlang.default_language_id = langd.language_id
					left join ods_imc_r_location_structure locs on com.location_id = locs.node_id 
					left join ods_imc_r_location_structure_d locd on locd.node_id = locs.node_id 
					left join (	select DISTINCT OBJECT_ID as "cd_course_id" ,skill_id from ods_imc_skill_value where objecttype_id = '3' and is_scheduled = '1')	      Courskill on com.component_id = Courskill.cd_course_id	
					-- Above join gets the skill associated with this course	
					and des.metatag_id not in ('10001','10002','10003','10011','10033','10035','10046','10047','10048','10049','10050','10051','10052','10053','10055','10056','10057','10058','10073','10094','10095','10096',
					'10098','10104','10106','10107','10108','10109','10110','10114','10117','10118','10123','10125','10126','10127','10131', '10134','10141','10152','10186','10192','10196','10750','10770','10955','10957','10960',
					'10969','11081','113262','113266','113268','113270','113272','113274','11420','11422','11423','11424','11425','11426','11427','114347', '11530','115333','11580','11705','117520','11802','11803','11804',
					'11805','11812','11814','11816','11821','11824','11836','11838','11870','119617','119627','119716','120485','12072','12073','122569',
					'126320','126411','133441','133621','134496','139753','1916666','3928546'
					)
			where des.metatag_id = '10072'
			and des.content = '3'   )   corinactive on com.component_id = corinactive.component_id  
where com.name not in ('Test LTI1.3')
and des.metatag_id not in (
'10001','10002','10003','10011','10033','10035','10046','10047','10048','10049','10050','10051','10052','10053','10055','10056','10057','10058','10073','10094','10095','10096','10098','10104','10106','10107','10108','10109','10110','10114','10117','10118','10123','10125','10126','10127','10131', '10134','10141','10152','10186','10192','10196','10750','10770','10955','10957','10960','10969','11081','113262','113266','113268','113270','113272','113274','11420','11422','11423','11424','11425','11426','11427','114347','11530','115333','11580','11705','117520','11802','11803','11804','11805','11812','11814','11816','11821','11824','11836','11838','11870','119617','119627','119716','120485','12072','12073','122569','126320','126411','133441','133621','134496','139753','1916666','3928546'		
)

select  
	per.person_id as "cd_individual_id",
	per.firstname as "de_individual_first_name", 
	per.lastname as "de_individual_last_name",         
        CASE WHEN per.multi_seat_purchase='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_eligible_more_than_1_seat ",
	COALESCE(comp.group_id, '0') as "cd_organization_id",
	per.email as "de_email_address",  
	COALESCE(perc.PHONE,'') as "de_phone_number",	
	COALESCE(per.city,'') as "de_city_name",
	CASE WHEN condnob.country_name = 'Unknown' then cond.country_name else condnob.country_name end as "de_country_name",
	CASE WHEN condnob.country_name = 'Unknown' then con.external_id else connob.external_id end as "cd_country_code",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_DATE_OF_BIRTH,'') as "dt_date_of_birth",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_LINKED_ACCOUNTS,'') as "de_iata_linked_accounts",
	COALESCE(perc.CUST_IATA_GLOBAL_ORG_ID,'') as "cd_iata_global_organization_id",
	COALESCE(perc.CUST_IATA_LEGACY_USER_ID,'') as "cd_yardstick_user_id", --(to map with old LMS User ID),
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_JOB_TITLE,'') as "de_iata_job_title",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_JOB_INDUSTRY,'') as "de_iata_job_industry",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_STATE,'') as "cd_iata_state",
	COALESCE(tz.java_identifier,'') as "de_timezone_name",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_POSTAL_CODE,'') as "de_iata_postal_codes",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_SYSADMIN ='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_sysadmin",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_INSTRUCTOR='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_instructor",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_TRAINING_COORDINATOR='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_training_coordinator",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_TC_SUPERUSER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_superuser",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_COM_TEAM_SUPERUSER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_team_superuser",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_CUSTOMER_SERVICE='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_customer_service",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_CUSTOMER_SERVICE_SUPER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_customer_service_super",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_SALES='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_sales",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_PRODUCT_MANAGER_SUPER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_product_manager_super",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_ATC_ADMIN='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_atc_admin",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_ATC_USER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_atc_user",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_ATC_INSTRUCTOR='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_atc_instructor",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_RTP_INSTRUCTOR='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_rtp_instructor",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_COMPANY_ADMIN='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_company_admin",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_PRODUCT_MANAGER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_product_manager",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_COM_TEAM_MEMBER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_com_team_member",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_RTP_USER='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_rtp_user",
	CASE when perc.IATA_IS_RTP_ADMIN='1' then 'true' else 'false' end as "is_iata_rtp_admin",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_INSTRUCTOR_NOTES,'') as "de_iata_instructor_notes",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_INSTRUCTOR_CONTRACT_INFOS,'') as "de_iata_instructor_contract_information",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_INSTRUCTOR_DAILY_RATE,'') as "nb_iata_instructor_daily_rate",
	COALESCE(perc.SAP_VENDOR,'') as "cd_sap_vendor",
	COALESCE(perc.SAP_MSA,'') as "cd_sap_msa",
	CASE WHEN per.type_id = '1' then 'Standard' WHEN per.type_id = '2' then 'Super' end as "cd_super_admin_type",
	COALESCE(per.login,'')  as "cd_salesforce_user_id",
	CASE when per.authentificationstatus_id = '1' and per.firstlogintime is not null then 'Active'
		 when per.authentificationstatus_id = '1' and per.firstlogintime is null then 'Registered'
		 else 'Inactive' end  as "cd_user_status",	
	COALESCE(per.creationtime,'') as "dt_account_creation_time",
	COALESCE(cl.name,'') as "cd_client_type",
	COALESCE(perc.IATA_STUDENT_TYPE,'') as "cd_student_type",
	COALESCE(per.countoflogins,'') as "ni_number_of_logins",
	COALESCE(per.firstlogintime,'') as "dt_first_login",
	COALESCE(per.lastlogintime,'') as "dt_last_login",
	per.lastupdated as "dt_last_update",
	per.lastupdater_id as "cd_last_updater_id", 
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
    NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
from ods_imc_person per
left join ods_imc_country con on per.country_id = con.id
left join ods_imc_client cl  on per.client_id = cl.client_id
left join (select * from ods_imc_country_d where language_id = '26')	 cond on con.id = cond.country_id
left join ods_imc_person_custom perc on per.person_id = perc.person_id 
left join (select * from ods_imc_country_d where language_id = '26') condnob on perc.iata_nationality_at_birth = condnob.country_id
left join ods_imc_country connob on perc.iata_nationality_at_birth = connob.id
left join ods_imc_timezone tz on per.timezone_id = tz.timezone_id
left join (select per.person_id,pgd.group_name,pggrp.group_id
			from ods_imc_person per
			left join ods_imc_person_custom perc on per.person_id = perc.person_id
			left join (select * from ods_imc_platformgroupspecification where group_id NOT IN ('111374', '135293') and type ='0' )  pgs on per.person_id = pgs.person_id
			left join (select * from ods_imc_platformgroup where root_id in ('135293','111374') and type_id = '1' ) pggrp ON pgs.group_id = pggrp.group_id 
			left join ods_imc_platformgroup_d pgd ON pgs.group_id = pgd.group_id and pgd.language_id='26'

SELECT 
 booking.booking_id as "cd_booking_id",
 booking.course_id as "cd_course_id",
 booking.person_id as "cd_booking_candidate_person_id",
 CASE	when booking.is_reserved = '1' and booking.status = '8' and booking.reservation_group_id != '0' THEN 'Group Reservation'
		when booking.is_reserved = '1' and booking.status = '8' and booking.reservation_group_id = '0' THEN 'Reserved'
		when booking.is_reserved = '0' AND cpg.user_status = '3' and booking.status = '11' THEN 'Passed with Distinction'
		when booking.is_reserved = '0' 	or booking.status = '7' THEN (
			SELECT property_value FROM ods_imc_clix_propvalues
			WHERE property_name = CONCAT('strCourseSubscriptionState_', booking.status) AND language_id = '26'
		    )
	    end AS "cd_booking_status",
 booking.status as "cd_booking_status_id",
 cpg.grade_percentage AS "nb_grade",
 booking.progress as "nb_progress",
 COALESCE(booktoken.token, '') AS "cd_token_id",
 COALESCE(ord_token.order_id, ord.order_id, '') as "cd_imc_order_id",
 COALESCE(ord_token.po_number, ord.po_number, '') as "de_order_number",
 COALESCE(ord_token.payment_status, ord.payment_status,'1') as "is_paid",    * convert - if 1 - 'true'  0 - 'false'
 COALESCE(ord_token.order_date, ord.order_date, '') as "dt_order_date",
 COALESCE(ord_token.person_id, ord.person_id, '0') as "cd_order_person_id",
 booking.is_reserved as "is_reserved",
/* when is reserved is 1 and the course to person status is 8  then the reserved status should be 18 otherwise use the course to person status */
case when booking.booking_date > booking.user_personal_start_date THEN booking.user_personal_start_date
else booking.booking_date
end AS "dt_booking_date",
 COALESCE(booking.user_personal_start_date, '') as "dt_user_personal_start_date",
 COALESCE(booking.user_personal_end_date, '') as "dt_user_personal_end_date",
 COALESCE(booking.course_access_granted_date, '') as "dt_course_access_granted_date",
 COALESCE(booking.course_access_expiry_date, '') as "dt_course_access_expiry_date",
 COALESCE(booking.cancellation_date, '') as "dt_cancellation_date",
 cand.name as "de_cancellation_reason",
 booking.changenotes as "de_enrolment_change_notes",
 perskill.skill_id as "cd_skill_id",
 perskill.skill_expiry_date as "dt_skill_expiry_date",
 pod.legacy_order_id as "cd_yardstick_order_number",
 pod.legacy_enrolment_key_id as "cd_yardstick_enrolment_key_id",
 pod.legacy_ATC_Code as "de_yardstick_atc_code",
 pod.legacy_Company_id as "cd_yardstick_company_id",
imc_tok1.person_id as "cd_token_holder_id",
 current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
 NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
FROM (		Select portf.person_id as "person_id", portf.component_id as "course_id",
			 course.name as "course_name", portf.enddate as "user_personal_end_date",
			 portf.startdate AS "user_personal_start_date", portf.course_enddate AS "course_access_expiry_date",
			 portf.status, portf.progress, portf.reservation_group_id,
			 portf.changenotes, portf.is_reserved,
			 portf.order_date AS booking_date, portf.portfolio_id as "booking_id",
			 portf.cancel_reason_id, portf.course_startdate AS "course_access_granted_date",
                         portf.cancel_date as "cancellation_date"
		    from ods_imc_portfolio portf
			JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON portf.component_id = course.component_id
			JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
		    WHERE course.is_template = '0'
			AND coursetemplate.characteristic_id = '4'
	 ) booking -- Gets Persons on Courses 77192
left JOIN ods_imc_person_custom perc ON booking.person_id = perc.person_id -- to get person custom columns
left join ods_imc_portfolio_token booktoken on booking.booking_id = booktoken.portfolio_id
left join (	select * from ods_imc_iata_order_token where token is null) ord on booking.Course_id = ord.course_id and booking.Person_id = ord.person_id --and ord.token is null
left join (	select * from ods_imc_iata_order_token where token IS NOT NULL) ord_token on booktoken.token = ord_token.token
left join ods_imc_person bookingper on booking.person_id = bookingper.person_id
left join ods_imc_person orderper on ord.Person_id = orderper.person_id
left join ods_imc_person orderper_token on ord_token.Person_id = orderper_token.person_id
left join ods_imc_custom_person_grade cpg on booking.person_id = cpg.person_id and booking.course_id = cpg.component_id
left join ( select reason_id, name from ods_imc_cancellation_reason_d where language_id = '26') cand on booking.cancel_reason_id = cand.reason_id and booking.status = '7'
left join ( select DISTINCT OBJECT_ID as "course_id", skill_id, expiry_date from ods_imc_skill_value 
            where objecttype_id = '3' and is_scheduled = '1'
	       ) courskill on booking.course_id = courskill.course_id
left join ( select DISTINCT OBJECT_ID as "person_id", skill_id, expiry_date as "skill_expiry_date"
		    from ods_imc_skill_value where objecttype_id = '1'
	      ) perskill on courskill.skill_id = perskill.skill_id
and perskill.person_id = booking.person_id
left join (	select value_9 as "legacy_order_id",value_13 as "legacy_enrolment_key_id",
			value_7 as "legacy_atc_code", value_4 as "legacy_company_id", portfolio_id
		    from ods_imc_person_order_data
	      ) pod on booking.booking_id = pod.portfolio_id
left join (select * from ods_imc_token) imc_tok1 on imc_tok1.token_id = booktoken.token

properties.name: is_day_record
properties.description:
This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true   

Discussed possible process:
is_day_record = (date(valid_to) > date(valid_from)) OR (valid_from = the latest valid_from for that key)

collections.comments:
Loading Fact

for each new record in dim_booking
begin
 load the fact record using the values from the latest dim_booking as below

For ALL dim_ids (except cd_dim_booking_id -this is the defining dimension of the table )  if a row can't be found in the dimension tables based on the where clauses listed below   then populate with the string 'Unknown'

   cd_dim_booking_id - from cd_dim_booking_id in dim_booking

   cd_dim_student_id - latest cd_dim_student_id from dim_student where
                                      dim_booking.cd_booking_candidate_person_id =
                                      dim_student.cd_individual_id (we need to bring it from dim_individual)

  cd_dim_token_holder_id - latest cd_dim_token_holder_id from dim_token_holder where
                dim_booking.cd_token_holder_id = dim_token_holder.cd_individual_id (we need to bring it from 
                 dim_individual)

   cd_dim_orderer_id - latest cd_dim_orderer_id from dim_orderer where dim_booking.cd_order_person_id = 
                dim_orderer.cd_individual_id(we need to bring it from dim_individual)

   cd_dim_course_id - latest cd_dim_course_id from dim_course where dim_booking.cd_course_id = 
                dim_course.cd_course_id

   cd_dim_order_id - latest  cd_dim_order_id  from dim_order where the
                dim_booking.de_order_number = dim_order.de_order_number

    cd_dim_venue_id -  latest cd_dim_venue_id from dim_venue joining on dim_booking.cd_course_id =
                 dim_course.cd_course_id and dim_venue.venue_id = dim_course.venue_id

   cd_dim_token_id - latest cd_dim_token_id from dim_token where dim_booking.cd_token_id = 
            dim_token.cd_token_id

   cd_dim_organization_id - latest  cd_dim_organization_id from dim_organization where dim_booking.cd_booking_candidate_person_id = dim_student.cd_individual_id and dim_student.cd_individual_id = dim_individual.cd_individual_id and dim_individual.cd_organization_id = dim_organization.cd_organization_id

  cd_dim_token_organization_id - latest cd_dim_organization_id from dim_organization where dim_booking.cd_token_id = dim_token.cd_token_id and dim_token.cd_organization_id = dim_organization.cd_organization_id

 cd_dim_course_template_id - latest cd_dim_course_template_id from dim_course_template where dim_booking.cd_course_id = dim_course.cd_course_id and dim_course.cd_course_template_object_id = dim_course_template.cd_course_template_object_id

   dt_valid_from  - current datetime
   dt_valid_to  - NULL 
   is_current - TRUE

   cd_custom_sales_channel :    
    (SELECT CASE
      WHEN tok_organization.cd_atc_code IS NOT NULL AND tok_organization.cd_atc_code <> '' THEN
                    'ATC'
      WHEN venue.venue_root_id IN ('157971', '4491922') THEN 
                    'RTP'
      WHEN venue.venue_root_id = '157974' THEN
                   'ACADEMIA'
      WHEN venue.venue_root_id NOT IN ('157971', '4491922','157974') AND course.de_private_public_prerequisite = 'Private' THEN
                  'INCO'
      WHEN venue.venue_root_id NOT IN ('157971', '4491922','157974') AND course.de_private_public_prerequisite = 'Public' THEN 
                  'ITC'
      ELSE 'DL'
            END AS custom_sales_channel
      FROM dim_imc_booking booking
   LEFT JOIN dim_imc_token tok ON booking.cd_token_id = tok.cd_token_id
   LEFT JOIN dim_imc_organization tok_organization ON tok.organization_id
                          =  tok_organization.organization_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_imc_venue venue ON booking.cd_venue_id = venue.cd_venue_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_imc_student student ON booking.cd_student_id = student.cd_student_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_imc_course course ON booking.cd_course_id = course.cd_course_id
       WHERE booking.is_current = True
       AND tok.is_current = True
       AND tok_organization.is_current = True
       AND venue.is_current = True
       AND course.is_current = True
       AND student.is_current = True
      )

  ni_number_of_days_to_first_login -   

     difference between 
       dim booking.dt_booking_date
       and   dim booking.cd_booking_candidate_person_id ->dim_student->dim_individual.dt_first_login     

  ni_number of days_to complete_course
      dim booking difference between dt_user_personal_end_date and dt_user_personal_start_date

  is_paid
      dim booking is_paid

  is_booking_completed
      if booking dim dt_user_personel_end_date is =< then loading (current/ fact /dt_valid_from) date   then
          'true'         
       else  'false'  

  is_booking_cancelled 
      if the booking dim dt_cancelled_date is =< then then loading (current/ fact /dt_valid_from)  date   then
         'true'    
       else  'false'

  nb_grade
      dim_booking nb_grade

  nb_progress
      dim_booking nb_progress

  ni_hours
      dim booking.cd_course_id -> dim_course.ni_hours

  ni_advance_days
      The difference in days 
      between
       dim booking.dt_booking_date 
       and (dim booking.cd_course_id -> dim_course.dt_course_start_date) 
      
  ni_advance_cancellation_days
      The difference in days 
      between
       dim_course.dt_course_start_date 
       and dim_booking.dt_cancellation_date

NOTES:

- We will need to the cd_booking_id as an anchor for the facts

- Once the dim IDs were selected using the logic above -> if the combination already exists for the
   cd_booking_id UPDATE otherwise CREATE a new record 

- If a new record is created the previous one is_current needs to be set to false and 'Valid To' to be filled with
 the date of the loading

properties.name: is_current
properties.description: Flags if this is the latest dimension for this business key.

properties.name: is_day_record
properties.description:
This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true   

Discussed possible process:
is_day_record = (date(valid_to) > date(valid_from)) OR (valid_from = the latest valid_from for that key)

collections.selectStatement:
loading logic

use the [Business id fields] in [staging table]
  
Get the latest loaded but not processed records.

For every record in the staging table that has not been processed
do 
   Compare each record to the latest matching (where is_current = true ) (based on [id fields]) in the [dim table] table.     

   if there is a record
    then
        if any of the following columns are different 
          [list the columns here ]
        then  
            create a new dim record in this [dim table]   
            with a unique dim id (pk) and 
            set the 'dt_valid_from' to current date time
            set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'  
            set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
            update existing current record  
                  set 'is_current' to 'false'
                  update the 'dt_valid_to' to  current date.    
        else
           update any other columns that are different in the current active dim record. 
    end     
   Else  -- there isn't an exsiting record
    then 
      create a new dim record  setting the 
      'dt_valid_from' to current data time  and
      set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'     and
      set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
    end



   for staging records processed 
     update the 'processed date' in the records processed  in the staging table.  

End  -- of for

SELECT
    qti.content_id AS "cd_question_id",
    qti.object_id AS "cd_question_object_id",
    qti.major_version AS "cd_question_version_number",
    qti.version as "cd_question_minor_version_number",
    qti.content_number as "cd_question_number",
    CASE 
        WHEN qti.is_topical_version = '1' THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END as "is_topical_version",
    qti.content_name AS "de_question_name",
    CASE
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'ev_multiplechoice' THEN 'Multiple choice'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'qti_multiplechoice' THEN 'Multiple choice'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'association' THEN 'Association'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'qti_singlechoice' THEN 'Single choice'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'freetext' THEN 'Free text'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'binarychoice' THEN 'Yes or No'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'imagemap_singlechoice' THEN 'Image Single Choice'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'imagemap_multiplechoice' THEN 'Image Multiple choice'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'qti_matrix' THEN 'Matrix'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'qti_matrix_singlechoice' THEN 'Matrix Single Choice'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'cloze' THEN 'Fill in the Blank'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'draganddrop_1_1' THEN 'Single Drag and Drop'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'draganddrop_n_1' THEN 'Multiple Drag and Drop'
        WHEN qtit.identifier = 'rearrange' THEN 'Rearrange'
        ELSE qtit.identifier
    END AS "de_question_type",
    CASE 
        WHEN qti.active = '1' THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END as "is_question_active",
    lang_d.language_name as "de_language",
    tid.question AS "de_question_text",
    cloze.subitem_text as "de_question_cloze_text",
    qti.score AS "nb_points_for_question",
    qti.enemy_question_ids AS "de_enemy_questions",
    qtid.description AS "de_question_description",
    qtid.educational_objectives as "de_educational_objectives",
    qti.content_keyword as "de_question_keywords",
    qti.duration as "de_average_time_taken",
    CASE 
        WHEN ti.point_type = '1' THEN 'Overall points for the question'
        WHEN ti.point_type = '2' THEN 'Points for each possible answer'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END as "de_question_grading_type",
    CASE 
        WHEN ti.zero_points_notansw = '1' THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END as "is_zero_points_no_answer",
    CASE 
        WHEN ti.zero_points_markedall = '1' THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END as "is_zero_points_all_answer",
    tid.online_instruction as "de_question_instructions_online",
    tid.offline_instruction as "de_question_instructions_offline",
    tid.feedback_positive as "de_response_if_correct",
    tid.feedback_positive as "de_response_if_wrong",
    tid.question_media as "de_question_media",
    qti.lastupdated as "dt_last_update",
    qti.updater_id as "cd_last_updated_by_id",
    qti.publishingdate as "dt_publishing_date",
    qti.publisher_id as "cd_publisher_id",
    qti.created as "dt_creation_date",
    qti.creator_id as "cd_creator_id", 
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
     NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
FROM (SELECT * FROM ods_imc_t_qti_content) qti
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ods_imc_t_qti_testitem) ti ON qti.content_id = ti.content_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ods_imc_t_qti_testitem_d WHERE language_id = '26') tid ON ti.content_id = tid.content_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ods_imc_t_qti_contenttype) qtit ON qti.contenttype_id = qtit.contenttype_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM ods_imc_t_qti_content_d WHERE language_id = '26') qtid ON qti.content_id = qtid.content_id
left join ods_imc_content_languages lang on lang.content_id = qti.content_id 
left join ods_imc_languagedefinition lang_d on lang_d.language_id = lang.language_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT cloze.content_id, cloze.subitem_text FROM ods_imc_t_qti_testsubitem_d cloze 
           JOIN ods_imc_t_qti_content qti ON qti.content_id = cloze.content_id 
           JOIN (SELECT * FROM ods_imc_t_qti_contenttype) qtit ON qti.contenttype_id = qtit.contenttype_id
           WHERE cloze.subitem_text <> '' and cloze.subitem_text IS NOT NULL and cloze.position = '0' and qtit.identifier = 'cloze'
) cloze ON cloze.content_id = qti.content_id 
WHERE qtit.contenttype_id IN ('201', '202', '203', '204', '205', '206', '207', '208', '209', '210', '211', '212', '213')

left join ods_imc_languagedefinition lang_d on lang_d.language_id = lang.language_id
left join ods_imc_attribute_visibility atr on atr.content_id = qti.content_id

collections.selectStatement:
Processing steps
Step 1:
In st_organization_stage1  where there are multiple records for a given  cd_organization_id + cd_metatag_id  grouping ,  create a single record by concatinating the contents of each records 'cd_admin_user' and inserting into a combined single row for 'cd_admin_user' .       
example 
cd_organization_id      de_organization_name         cd_admin_user_id        cd_metatag_id
423897	                       Thomas More Mechelen	 564689	                         ATC 114347
423897	                       Thomas More Mechelen	 4043687	                 ATC 114347
convert to  
423897                           Thomas More Mechelen      564689,4043687          ATC 114347
   
Step 2:
pivot st_organization_stage1 rows into single row per cd_organization_id .   Use rows per metatag_id to populate fields as described in the 'columns marked in red's remarks field in st_organization_stage2 table. 

step 3
populate de_head_organsation_name
using following logic
default to ''

properties.name: de_product_name
properties.comments:
IF cd_sap_core_material_number =  'InactiveProduct' THEN   de_course_template_name
ELSE
Group ny SAP Core Material Number:  (one or more rows)
use the following logic in this priority order to find the row we use for the product_name.
e.g if we find a row which has a delivery method of  Virtual Classroom  but don't find  a row with a delivery method 
of Classroom then we use that row.
IF a row exists with de_delivery_method = 'Classroom' AND de_language = 'US-English' THEN take the de_course_template_name from that row 
ELSE
IF a row exists  with de_delivery_method  = 'Virtual Classroom' AND de_language = 'US-English' THEN take the de_course_template_name from that row
ELSE
IF a row exists with de_delivery_method = 'E-learning' AND de_language = 'US-English' THEN take the de_course_template_name from that row
ELSE
IF a row exists with de_delivery_method = 'E-book' AND de_language = 'US-English' THEN take the de_course_template_name from that row
ELSE
IF a row exists with de_delivery_method = 'Blended learning' AND de_language = 'US-English' THEN take the de_course_template_name from that row
ELSE
IF a row exists with de_language = 'US-English' THEN take the de_course_template_name from that row
ELSE take the de_course_template_name from the highest alphabetical row.

collections.selectStatement:
Step 1:
pivot st_course template_stage1 rows into single row per cd_course template_id .   Use rows per metatag_id to populate fields as described in the 'columns marked in red's remarks field in st_course template_stage2 table. 
Step 2:
for ALL records update the dt_course_start_date and dt_course_end_date  from Europe/Berlin   to  the timezone specified in 'de_time_zone' from st_imc_timezone.java_identifier joining on cd_timezone_id which is a metatag in stage1 
Step 3:
populate de_product_name  using the logic in the remarks field for this column.  
This relies on the creation fo the cd_sap_core_material_number

AWS Athena :

select 
	comp.id as "cd_course_exam_id",
	com.component_id as "cd_course_id",
	qti.content_id as "cd_exam_id",  --content_id 
	COALESCE(comp.progress_weight, '0') AS "ni_progress_weight",
	case when comp.update_id ='0' then false when comp.update_id ='1' then true else false end  as "is_update_id",
	comp.startdate as "dt_start_date",
	comp.enddate as "dt_end_date",
	comp.try_count as "ni_maximum_number_of_attempts",
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
    NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
from (select * from ods_imc_e_component where is_template = '0' and archive = '0') com      --not a template
left join (select * from ods_imc_e_componenttype where characteristic_id = '4' ) comt on com.type_id = comt.componenttype_id   
left join (select * from ods_imc_e_composing  ) comp on com.component_id = comp.composing_id
left join (select * from  ods_imc_t_qti_content  ) qti on comp.component_id = qti.content_id
join (select * from  ods_imc_t_qti_contenttype where contenttype_id in ('2','9') ) qtit  on qti.contenttype_id = qtit.contenttype_id  -- exams




Transact SQL:
select 
	com.component_id as 'cd_course_id',
	com.object_id as 'cd_course_object_id',
	com.name as 'de_course_name',
	qti.content_id as 'cd_exam_id',  --content_id 
	qti.object_id as 'cd_exam_object_id', -- displays in app
	qti.content_name as'de_exam_name',
	qti.content_keyword as 'de_exam_content_keyword',
	qti.major_version as 'cd_exam_version_number',
	comp.progress_weight as 'ni_progress weight',
	case when comp.update_id =0 then 'false' when comp.update_id =1 then 'true' else 'false' end  as 'is_update_id',
	comp.startdate as 'dt_start_date',
	comp.enddate as 'dt_end_date',
	comp.try_count as 'ni_maximum_number_of_attempts'

SELECT DISTINCT
    user_exam_question.evaluation_id as "cd_user_exam_evaluation_id",
    user_exam_question.candidate_id as "cd_individual_id",
    user_exam_question.content_id as "cd_exam_id",
    user_exam_question.container_id as "cd_course_id",
    user_exam_question.testitem_id as "cd_question_id",
    CASE 
        WHEN user_exam_question.item_result_status = '-1' THEN 'Not Yet Evaluated'
        WHEN user_exam_question.item_result_status = '0' THEN 'Answered Incorrectly'
        WHEN user_exam_question.item_result_status = '1' THEN 'Answered Correctly'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END as "de_user_exam_question_status",
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY user_exam_question.container_id, user_exam_question.content_id, user_exam_question.candidate_id, user_exam_question.testitem_id
        ORDER BY CAST(user_exam_question.evaluation_id AS INTEGER)
    ) AS "ni_exam_booking_attempt",
    CASE 
        WHEN (question.point_type = '2') THEN SUM(CAST(user_exam_question.evaluated_score AS DECIMAL(18,4))) OVER (PARTITION BY user_exam_question.container_id, user_exam_question.content_id, user_exam_question.testitem_id, user_exam_question.evaluation_id)
        ELSE CAST(user_exam_question.evaluated_score AS DECIMAL(18,4))
    end AS "nb_points_achieved",
    CASE
        WHEN question_i.contenttype_id IN ('205','206') THEN array_join(array_agg(user_exam_question.response) OVER (PARTITION BY user_exam_question.container_id, user_exam_question.content_id, user_exam_question.testitem_id, user_exam_question.evaluation_id), ' | ')
        else user_exam_question.response
    end as "de_free_text_response",
    -- user_exam_question.response as "de_free_text_response",
    user_exam_question.evaluator_comment as "de_evaluator_comment",
    user_exam_question.evaluator_id as "cd_evaluator_id",
    user_exam_question.evaluator_reason as "de_evaluator_reason",
    CASE 
        WHEN user_exam_question.item_process_status = '1' then 'Worked On'
        WHEN user_exam_question.item_process_status = '0' then 'Not Worked On'
    end as "de_user_exam_question_access_status",
    user_exam_question.evaluation_date as "dt_user_exam_question_evaluation_date",
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
    NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
FROM ods_imc_t_qti_testplayer_resp_log user_exam_question
JOIN ods_imc_t_qti_testitem question on question.content_id = user_exam_question.testitem_id
JOIN ods_imc_t_qti_content question_i on question_i.content_id = user_exam_question.testitem_id
ORDER BY user_exam_question.container_id, user_exam_question.content_id, user_exam_question.candidate_id , user_exam_question.evaluation_id

properties.description:
This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true   

Discussed possible process:
is_day_record = (date(valid_to) > date(valid_from)) OR (valid_from = the latest valid_from for that key)

collections.selectStatement:
loading logic

use the [Business id fields] in [staging table]
  
Get the latest loaded but not processed records.

For every record in the staging table that has not been processed
do 
   Compare each record to the latest matching (where is_current = true )  (based on [id fields]) in the [dim table] table.     

   if there is a record
    then
        if any of the following columns are different 
          [list the columns here ]
        then  
            create a new dim record in this [dim table]   
            with a unique dim id (pk) and 
            set the 'dt_valid_from' to current date time
            set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'  
            set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
            update existing current record  
                  set 'is_current' to 'false'
                  update the 'dt_valid_to' to  current date.    
        else
           update any other columns that are different in the current active dim record. 
    end     
   Else  -- there isn't an exsiting record
    then 
      create a new dim record  setting the 
      'dt_valid_from' to current data time  and
      set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'     and
      set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
    end



   for staging records processed 
     update the 'processed date' in the records processed  in the staging table.  

End  -- of for

properties.name: is_day_record
properties.description:
This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true   

Discussed possible process:
is_day_record = (date(valid_to) > date(valid_from)) OR (valid_from = the latest valid_from for that key)

collections.selectStatement:
loading logic

use the [Business id fields] in [staging table]
  
Get the latest loaded but not processed records.

For every record in the staging table that has not been processed
do 
   Compare each record to the latest matching (where is_current = true )  (based on [id fields]) in the [dim table] table.     

   if there is a record
    then
        if any of the following columns are different 
          [list the columns here ]
        then  
            create a new dim record in this [dim table]   
            with a unique dim id (pk) and 
            set the 'dt_valid_from' to current date time
            set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'  
            set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
            update existing current record  
                  set 'is_current' to 'false'
                  update the 'dt_valid_to' to  current date.    
        else
           update any other columns that are different in the current active dim record. 
    end     
   Else  -- there isn't an exsiting record
    then 
      create a new dim record  setting the 
      'dt_valid_from' to current data time  and
      set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'     and
      set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
    end



   for staging records processed 
     update the 'processed date' in the records processed  in the staging table.  

End  -- of for

loading logic

Using the cd_course_template_id  in st_imc_course_template_stage2

Get the latest loaded but not processed records.

For every record in the staging table that has not been processed
do 
   Compare each record to the latest matching (where is_current = true ) cd_course_template_course_id in the dim_course_template table.     
   if there is a record
    then
        if any of the following columns are different 
( type 2 )
           ni_hours
           is_new
           de_private_public_prerequisite
           ni_running_time_in_days
        then  
            create a new dim record in this [dim table]   
            with a unique dim id (pk) and 
            set the 'dt_valid_from' to current date time
            set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'  
            set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
            update existing current record  
                  set 'is_current' to 'false'
                  update the 'dt_valid_to' to  current date.    
        else
(All the other columns are type 1) 
           update any other columns that are different in the current active dim record. 
    end     
   Else  -- there isn't an exsiting record
    then 
      create a new dim record  setting the 
      'dt_valid_from' to current data time  and
      set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'     and
      set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
    end

   for staging records processed 
     update the 'processed date' in the records processed  in the staging table.  

End  -- of for

      ( Standard fix when there's no delete event: detect deletes by absence)
        For every new record processed .  check if the newly processed staging record is missing a 
        cd_course_template_course_id  record that previously existed .  If so  then perform a soft delete on the existing

1. Load the learning path bookings from st_imc_learning_path_booking_stage1

2. Bring the following information from st_imc_learning_path_booking_custom_stage1 grouped by (cd_learning_path_id, cd_booking_candidate_person_id) on st_imc_learning_path_booking_stage1.cd_individual_id = st_imc_learning_path_booking_custom_stage1.cd_booking_candidate_person_id:
- ni_mandatory_course_templates_completed -> the number of mandatory course templates completed using the flag is_mandatory = True 
- ni_elective_course_templates_completed -> the number of elective course templates completed is_mandatory = False 
- nb_learning_path_mandatory_progress -> the mandatory progress = ni_mandatory_course_templates_completed / ni_mandatory_course_templates
- nb_learning_path_elective_progress -> the elective progress =  MIN(ni_elective_course_templates_completed, ni_number_of_electives_required) / ni_number_of_electives_required
- nb_learning_path_overall_progress -> the overall progress = (ni_mandatory_course_templates_completed + MIN(ni_elective_course_templates_completed, ni_number_of_electives_required)) / (ni_mandatory_course_templates+ ni_number_of_electives_required)
- dt_learning_path_start_date -> the earliest date completed based on dt_user_personal_end_date
- dt_learning_path_end_date -> the latest date completed based on dt_user_personal_end_date
- ni_learning_path_months_taken -> the number of months in between dt_learning_path_end_date and dt_learning_path_start_date
- de_learning_path_status -> 
IF ni_mandatory_course_templates_completed = ni_mandatory_course_templates 
AND ni_elective_course_templates_completed >= ni_number_of_electives_required
AND ni_learning_path_months_taken <= de_duration_of_use
THEN 'Completed'
ELSE 'In Progress'

SELECT 
    book.portfolio_id as "cd_booking_id",
    book.course_id as "cd_course_id",
    book.person_id as "cd_individual_id",
    user_comp.component_id as "cd_component_id",
    user_comp.object_id as "cd_component_object_id",
    user_comp.user_component_booking_id as "cd_component_booking_id",
    course_component.id as "cd_course_component_id", 
    user_comp.try_count as "ni_number_of_attempts",
    user_comp.tracking_count as "ni_number_of_accesses",
    user_comp.user_progress_status as "de_user_progress_status",
    user_comp.result as "nb_component_grade_result",
    user_comp.evaluated_score as "nb_points_achieved",
    user_comp.failed_count as "ni_number_of_failed_attempts",
    user_comp.startdate as "dt_component_start_date",
    user_comp.enddate as "dt_component_end_date",
    user_comp.progress as "nb_progress",
    user_comp.is_processed as "is_processed",
    user_comp.tutor_confirm as "is_tutor_confirm",
    user_comp.participant_confirm as "is_participant_confirm",
    user_comp.lastupdated as "dt_last_update",
    user_comp.lastupdater_id as "cd_last_updated_by_id",
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
    NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
FROM
(SELECT portf.portfolio_id as "portfolio_id",
             portf.person_id as "person_id",
             portf.component_id as "course_id",
             portf.status as "status"
      FROM ods_imc_portfolio portf
	  JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON portf.component_id = course.component_id
	  JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
	  WHERE course.is_template = '0'
	  AND coursetemplate.characteristic_id = '4'
  	  AND portf.is_reserved = '0'
) book 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_comp.portfolio_id as "user_component_booking_id",
           user_comp.person_id as "component_person_id",
           user_comp.component_id as "component_id",
           component.object_id as "object_id",
           user_comp.course_id as "component_course_id",
           (SELECT property_value FROM ods_imc_clix_propvalues WHERE property_name = CONCAT('strCourseSubscriptionState_', user_comp.status) AND language_id = '26') as "user_progress_status",
           user_comp.tracking_count as "tracking_count",
           user_comp.startdate as "startdate",
           user_comp.enddate as "enddate",
           CASE WHEN user_comp.result = '-1.0000' THEN ''
                ELSE user_comp.result
           END as "result",
           user_comp.try_count as "try_count",
           CASE WHEN user_comp.evaluated_score = '0E-7' THEN ''
                ELSE user_comp.evaluated_score
           END as "evaluated_score",
           user_comp.failed as "failed_count",
           CASE WHEN user_comp.tutor_confirm = '0' THEN 'False'
                ELSE 'True'
           END as "tutor_confirm",
           CASE WHEN user_comp.participant_confirm = '0' THEN 'False'
                ELSE 'True'
           END as "participant_confirm",
           CASE WHEN user_comp.progress = '0' and user_comp.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN '100'
                ELSE user_comp.progress
           END as "progress",
           CASE WHEN user_comp.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN 'True'
                ELSE 'False'
           END as "is_processed",
           user_comp.lastupdated as "lastupdated",
           user_comp.lastupdater_id as "lastupdater_id"
    FROM ods_imc_portfolio user_comp
    JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON user_comp.course_id = course.component_id
    left JOIN ods_imc_e_component component ON user_comp.component_id = component.component_id
    JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id) user_comp on book.course_id = user_comp.component_course_id and book.person_id = user_comp.component_person_id
left join ods_imc_e_composing course_component on course_component.composing_id = user_comp.component_course_id and course_component.component_id = user_comp.component_id

select 
    skill.skill_id as "cd_skill_id",
    skill.external_object_id as "cd_external_object_id",
    skill.external_system_id as "cd_external_system_id",
    skill_d.name as "de_skill_name",
    skill_d.description as "de_skill_description",
    skill_d.teaser as "de_skill_job_area",
    skill_d.reference as "de_skill_reference",
    skill_d.context as "de_skill_context",
    scale_d.name as "de_scale",
    skill.comp_structure_id as "cd_scale_id",
    case
        when skill.status = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.status = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_active",
    case
        when skill.confirmation_mode = '0' then 'Confirmation not applied'
        when skill.confirmation_mode = '1' then 'Confirmation by supervisor/administrator required'
        when skill.confirmation_mode = '2' then 'Denial by supervisor/administrator possible'
        when skill.confirmation_mode = '5' then 'Confirmation by completing a learning activity'
        when skill.confirmation_mode = '6' then 'Confirmation by Competency Evaluation'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as "de_confirmation_mode",
    case
        when skill.is_scheduled = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.is_scheduled = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_scheduled_to_expire",
    skill.schedule_days as "ni_days_to_expire",
    skill.schedule_date as "dt_expire_at",
    case
        when skill.validation_relevant = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.validation_relevant = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_validation_relevant",
    case
        when skill.ranking_assessment = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.ranking_assessment = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_evaluation_through_scales",
    case
        when skill.assignment_by_accumulation = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.assignment_by_accumulation = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_level_assignment_by_accumulation",
    case
        when skill.parallel_expiration = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.parallel_expiration = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_parallel_expiration_considered",
    case
        when skill.level_selection_mandatory = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.level_selection_mandatory = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_level_selection_mandatory_for_assessment",
    skill.required_yes_answer_percentage as "nb_required_yes_answer_percentage",
    case
        when skill.schedule_form = '0' then 'completely'
        when skill.schedule_form = '1' then 'by the following number of levels:'
        when skill.schedule_form = '2' then 'to the most recently achieved level'
        when skill.schedule_form = '3' then 'by the following number of points:'
        when skill.schedule_form = '4' then 'to the most recent achieved points'
        else 'Unknown'
    end as "de_expiry_form",
    skill.schedule_levels as "ni_schedule_levels",
    skill.schedule_points as "ni_schedule_points",
    skill.creator_id as "cd_skill_created_by",
    skill.creation_date as "dt_skill_created_at",
    skill.lastupdater_id as "cd_skill_last_updated_by",
    skill.lastupdated as "dt_skill_last_updated_at",
    skill.certificate_id as "cd_skill_certificate_id",
    case
        when skill.certificate_access = '0' then 'False'
        when skill.certificate_access = '1' then 'True'
        else 'False'
    end as "is_certificate_accessible_by_user",
    case
        WHEN skill.skill_id IN (SELECT skill_id from ods_imc_skill_node_composing where node_id = '134718') THEN 'True'
        ELSE 'False'
    END AS "is_assigned_to_certification",
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
     NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
from ods_imc_skill skill 
left join (select * from ods_imc_skill_description where language_id = '26') skill_d on skill_d.skill_id = skill.skill_id
left join (select * from ods_imc_t_competency_structure_d where language_id = '26') scale_d on scale_d.comp_structure_id = skill.comp_structure_id

select

    course_skill.schedule_levels as "ni_schedule_levels",

        when course_skill.schedule_form = '0' then 'completely'

        when course_skill.schedule_form = '3' then 'by the following number of points:'

properties.name: is_day_record
properties.description:
This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true   

Discussed possible process:
is_day_record = (date(valid_to) > date(valid_from)) OR (valid_from = the latest valid_from for that key)

update the dt_processes_utc column in the st_exams_stage1 as the records have been processed and successfully inserted into st_exams_stage2

Find the parent folder names recursively until there is no parent.

"top level name > child level > child level ...... > current record folder name"

Select	topic.topic_id as "cd_classification_id", 
                root.rootid as "cd_classification_root_id",
		topic.parent_id as "cd_classification_parent_id", 
		COALESCE(topic.name,'') as "de_classification_topic_name", 
		COALESCE(topic.Topic_description,'') as "de_classification_topic_description",
		root.rootname as "de_classification_root_name", 
		topic.archive  as "is_deleted",
                topic.lastupdater_id as "cd_last_updater_id", 
                topic.lastupdated as "dt_last_updated",
                topic.creator_id as "cd_creator_id",
                topic.created as "dt_created",
	        topic.parent_ids as "de_classification_topic_parent_hierarchy",
                current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
                NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
from (	select troot.root_id as "rootid", trdesc.name as "rootname"
		from ods_imc_topic_root troot
		left join ods_imc_topic_root_d trdesc on troot.root_id = trdesc.root_id 
	 )  root
join	(	select t.topic_id, t.parent_id,t.parent_ids, t.root_id,  tdesc.title as "name",tdesc.description as "Topic_description",
                       t.archive,t.lastupdater_id,t.lastupdated,t.creator_id,t.created
				from ods_imc_topic t
				left join (select * from ods_imc_topic_description where language_id = '26') tdesc on t.topic_id = tdesc.topic_id 
			 )   topic on root.rootid = topic.root_id

properties.name: is_current
properties.description: Flags if this is the latest dimension for this business key.

properties.name: is_day_record
properties.description:
This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true

SELECT 
    book.portfolio_id as "cd_booking_id",
    book.course_id as "cd_course_id",
    book.person_id as "cd_individual_id",
    user_exam.exam_booking_id as "cd_exam_booking_id",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.exam_id, user_exam.exam_id) AS "cd_exam_id",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.exam_object_id, user_exam.exam_object_id) AS "cd_exam_object_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(user_exam_attempt.try_count AS varchar), user_exam.try_count) AS "ni_exam_booking_attempt",
    course_exam.id as "cd_course_exam_id", 
    CASE
        WHEN DATE(CAST(exam_booking.scheduling_startdate AS TIMESTAMP)) < CURRENT_DATE and user_exam.exam_status IN ('Enrolled (not started)','Waiting','In progress')
            THEN 'No Show'
        ELSE COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.exam_status, user_exam.exam_status)
    END AS "de_exam_booking_status",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.result, user_exam.result) AS "nb_exam_grade_result",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.evaluated_score, user_exam.evaluated_score) AS "nb_points_achieved",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.tracking_count, user_exam.tracking_count) AS "ni_number_of_accesses",
    -- COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.failed_count, user_exam.failed_count) AS "ni_number_of_failed_attempts",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.startdate, user_exam.startdate) AS "dt_exam_start_date",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.enddate, user_exam.enddate) AS "dt_exam_end_date",
    exam_booking.scheduling_startdate as "dt_exam_booking_date_time",
    CAST(
        date_format(
            at_timezone(
                with_timezone(
                    CAST(exam_booking.scheduling_startdate AS timestamp),
                    CASE tmz.java_identifier
                        WHEN 'EST' THEN 'America/New_York'
                        WHEN 'CST' THEN 'America/Chicago'
                        WHEN 'MST' THEN 'America/Denver'
                        WHEN 'PST' THEN 'America/Los_Angeles'
                    ELSE tmz.java_identifier
                    END
                ),
                'Europe/Berlin'
            ),
            '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'
        ) AS timestamp
    ) AS "dt_exam_booking_local_date_time",
    CASE WHEN exam_booking.infringement = '1' THEN 'Evaluation pending'
         WHEN exam_booking.infringement = '2' THEN 'Incident Confirmed'
         WHEN exam_booking.infringement = '3' THEN 'No Incident'
         ELSE ''
    END as "de_exam_proctoring_status",
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
    NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
FROM
(SELECT portf.portfolio_id as "portfolio_id",
             portf.person_id as "person_id",
             portf.component_id as "course_id",
             portf.status as "status"
      FROM ods_imc_portfolio portf
	  JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON portf.component_id = course.component_id
	  JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
	  WHERE course.is_template = '0'
	  AND coursetemplate.characteristic_id = '4'
  	  AND portf.is_reserved = '0'
) book 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_exam.portfolio_id as "exam_booking_id",
           user_exam.person_id as "exam_person_id",
           user_exam.component_id as "exam_id",
           user_exam.course_id as "exam_course_id",
           (SELECT property_value FROM ods_imc_clix_propvalues WHERE property_name = CONCAT('strCourseSubscriptionState_', user_exam.status) AND language_id = '26') as "exam_status",
           user_exam.tracking_count as "tracking_count",
           user_exam.startdate as "startdate",
           user_exam.enddate as "enddate",
           CASE WHEN user_exam.result = '-1.0000' THEN ''
                ELSE user_exam.result
           END as "result",
           user_exam.try_count as "try_count",
           CASE WHEN user_exam.evaluated_score = '0E-7' THEN ''
                ELSE user_exam.evaluated_score
           END as "evaluated_score",
           user_exam.failed as "failed_count",
           qti.object_id as "exam_object_id"
    FROM ods_imc_portfolio user_exam
    JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON user_exam.course_id = course.component_id
    JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
    LEFT JOIN ods_imc_t_qti_content qti on user_exam.component_id = qti.content_id
    JOIN (select * from  ods_imc_t_qti_contenttype where contenttype_id in ('2','9') ) qtit  on qti.contenttype_id = qtit.contenttype_id) user_exam on book.course_id = user_exam.exam_course_id and book.person_id = user_exam.exam_person_id
left JOIN (
	       WITH exam_data AS (
                SELECT
                    user_exam_attempt.learning_log_id as exam_booking_attempt_id,
                    user_exam_attempt.person_id as exam_person_id,
                    user_exam_attempt.component_id as exam_id,
                    user_exam_attempt.course_id as exam_course_id,
                    (SELECT property_value
                     FROM ods_imc_clix_propvalues
                     WHERE property_name = CONCAT('strCourseSubscriptionState_', user_exam_attempt.result_state)
                       AND language_id = '26') as exam_status,
                    user_exam_attempt.tracking_count,
                    user_exam_attempt.start_date as startdate,
                    user_exam_attempt.end_date as enddate,
                    CASE
                        WHEN user_exam_attempt.result = '-1.0000' THEN ''
                        ELSE user_exam_attempt.result
                    END as result,
                    user_exam_attempt.try_count as "imc_try_count",
                    CASE
                        WHEN user_exam_attempt.evaluated_score = '0E-7' THEN ''
                        ELSE user_exam_attempt.evaluated_score
                    END as evaluated_score,
                    user_exam_attempt.failed as failed_count,
                    qti.object_id as exam_object_id,
                    qti.content_id,
                    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY user_exam_attempt.course_id,
                                     qti.content_id,
                                     user_exam_attempt.person_id
                        ORDER BY CAST(user_exam_attempt.end_date AS TIMESTAMP)
                    ) AS try_count
                FROM (select * from ods_imc_learning_log where try_count <> '0' and person_id = lastupdater_id and result_state IN ('11','12') and start_date <> end_date and language_id <> '-1') user_exam_attempt
                JOIN ods_imc_e_component course
                    ON user_exam_attempt.course_id = course.component_id
                JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate
                    ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
                LEFT JOIN ods_imc_t_qti_content qti
                    ON user_exam_attempt.component_id = qti.content_id
                JOIN (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM ods_imc_t_qti_contenttype
                    WHERE contenttype_id IN ('2','9')
                ) qtit
                    ON qti.contenttype_id = qtit.contenttype_id
            ),
            ranked_data AS (
                SELECT
                    *,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY exam_course_id,
                                     content_id,
                                     exam_person_id,
                                     try_count
                        ORDER BY CAST(exam_booking_attempt_id AS BIGINT) DESC
                    ) AS rn
                FROM exam_data
            )
            SELECT *
            FROM ranked_data
            WHERE rn = 1
	       ) user_exam_attempt on user_exam_attempt.exam_course_id = user_exam.exam_course_id and user_exam_attempt.exam_person_id = user_exam.exam_person_id and user_exam_attempt.exam_id = user_exam.exam_id
left join ods_imc_e_composing course_exam on course_exam.composing_id = user_exam.exam_course_id and course_exam.component_id = user_exam.exam_id
left join ods_imc_meazure_learning_session exam_booking on exam_booking.course_id = book.course_id and exam_booking.person_id = book.person_id and exam_booking.test_id = user_exam.exam_id
left join ods_imc_person per on per.person_id = user_exam.exam_person_id
left join ods_imc_timezone tmz on tmz.timezone_id = per.timezone_id
where (user_exam_attempt.rn = 1 OR user_exam_attempt.rn IS NULL)

collections.selectStatement:
Step 1.

For each Course Booking from st_imc_booking table we create a placeholder exam booking based on the Exam already existing in the table st_imc_course_exam

Step 2.
Populate the Placeholder exam bookings with the information from the st_imc_exam_booking_stage1 if it exist. This may also cover the multiple attempts per exam booking

Step 3.

       tasklist.tasklist_id as "cd_tasklist_id",
       tasklist.title as "de_tasklist_name",
       tasklist.description as "de_tasklist_description",
       language.language_name as "de_tasklist_language",
       CASE 
            WHEN tasklist.is_template = '1' THEN 'True'
            ELSE 'False'
       END AS "is_tasklist_template",
       CASE 
            WHEN tasklist.archive = '1' THEN 'True'
            ELSE 'False'
       END AS "is_tasklist_deleted",
       tasklist.creator_id as "cd_tasklist_created_by",
       tasklist.creationdate as "dt_tasklist_created_at",
       tasklist.lastupdater_id as "cd_tasklist_last_updated_by",
       tasklist.lastupdated as "dt_tasklist_last_updated_at",
       current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",

where tasklist.is_template = '1'

collections.selectStatement:
loading logic

  
Get the latest loaded but not processed records from st_imc_exam_stage2

For every record in the staging table that has not been processed
do 
   Compare each record to the latest matching (where is_current = true ) cd_exam_id in the dim_exam table.     
   if there is a record
    then
        if any of the following columns are different 
( type 2 )

        then  
            create a new dim record in this [dim table]   
            with a unique dim id (pk) and 
            set the 'dt_valid_from' to current date time
            set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'  
            set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
            update existing current record  
                  set 'is_current' to 'false'
                  update the 'dt_valid_to' to  current date.    
        else
(All the other columns are type 1) 
           update any other columns that are different in the current active dim record. 
    end     
   Else  -- there isn't an exsiting record
    then 
      create a new dim record  setting the 
      'dt_valid_from' to current data time  and
      set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'     and
      set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
    end

   for staging records processed 
     update the 'processed date' in the records processed  in the staging table.  

End  -- of for


( Standard fix when there's no delete event: detect deletes by absence)
For every new record processed .  check if the newly processed staging record is missing a cd_exam_id record that previously existed .  If so  then perform a soft delete on the existing


is_day_record


This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true   

Discussed possible process:
is_day_record = (date(valid_to) > date(valid_from)) OR (valid_from = the latest valid_from for that key)


If a dimension is soft closed for the day (is_day_record = False)   then we need to add to the processing a step to update the is_day_record  in ANY fact table row with that soft closed dimension in them.

Loading Fact

for each new record in dim_exam_booking
begin
 load the fact record using the values from the latest dim_exam_booking as below

For ALL dim_ids (except cd_dim_exam_booking_id - this is the defining dimension of the table) if a row can't be found in the dimension tables based on the where clauses listed below   then populate with the string 'Unknown'

cd_dim_booking_id - latest cd_dim_booking_id in dim_booking where dim_exam_booking.cd_booking_id = dim_booking.cd_booking_id
cd_dim_course_id - latest cd_dim_course_id in dim_course where dim_exam_booking.cd_course_id = dim_course.cd_course_id
cd_dim_exam_id - latest cd_dim_exam_id in dim_exam where dim_exam_booking.cd_exam_id = dim_exam.cd_exam_id
cd_dim_student_id - latest cd_dim_student_id from dim_student where dim_exam_booking.cd_individual_id = dim_student.cd_individual_id (we need to bring it from dim_individual)

	    WHEN ecomp.autobooking = '0' THEN 'False'

    END as "is_assessment_required",

    case

    end as "is_scheduled_to_expire",

        when course_skill.schedule_form = '0' then 'completely'
        when course_skill.schedule_form = '1' then 'by the following number of levels:'
        when course_skill.schedule_form = '2' then 'to the most recently achieved level'
        when course_skill.schedule_form = '3' then 'by the following number of points:'

    end as "de_expiry_form",
    case

        when course_skill.confirmation_status = '1' then 'Confirmation by supervisor/administrator required'
        when course_skill.confirmation_status = '2' then 'Denial by supervisor/administrator possible'
