SELECT 
    book.portfolio_id as "cd_booking_id",
    book.course_id as "cd_course_id",
    book.person_id as "cd_individual_id",
    user_exam.exam_booking_id as "cd_exam_booking_id",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.exam_id, user_exam.exam_id) AS "cd_exam_id",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.exam_object_id, user_exam.exam_object_id) AS "cd_exam_object_id",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.try_count, user_exam.try_count) AS "ni_exam_booking_attempt",
    course_exam.id as "cd_course_exam_id", 
    CASE
        WHEN DATE(CAST(exam_booking.scheduling_startdate AS TIMESTAMP)) < CURRENT_DATE and user_exam.exam_status IN ('Enrolled (not started)','Waiting','In progress')
            THEN 'No Show'
        ELSE COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.exam_status, user_exam.exam_status)
    END AS "de_exam_booking_status",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.result, user_exam.result) AS "nb_exam_grade_result",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.evaluated_score, user_exam.evaluated_score) AS "nb_points_achieved",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.tracking_count, user_exam.tracking_count) AS "ni_number_of_accesses",
    -- COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.failed_count, user_exam.failed_count) AS "ni_number_of_failed_attempts",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.startdate, user_exam.startdate) AS "dt_exam_start_date",
    COALESCE(user_exam_attempt.enddate, user_exam.enddate) AS "dt_exam_end_date",
    exam_booking.scheduling_startdate as "dt_exam_booking_date_time",
    CAST(
        date_format(
            at_timezone(
                with_timezone(
                    CAST(exam_booking.scheduling_startdate AS timestamp),
                    CASE tmz.java_identifier
                        WHEN 'EST' THEN 'America/New_York'
                        WHEN 'CST' THEN 'America/Chicago'
                        WHEN 'MST' THEN 'America/Denver'
                        WHEN 'PST' THEN 'America/Los_Angeles'
                    ELSE tmz.java_identifier
                    END
                ),
                'Europe/Berlin'
            ),
            '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'
        ) AS timestamp
    ) AS "dt_exam_booking_local_date_time",
    CASE WHEN exam_booking.infringement = '1' THEN 'Evaluation pending'
         WHEN exam_booking.infringement = '2' THEN 'Incident Confirmed'
         WHEN exam_booking.infringement = '3' THEN 'No Incident'
         ELSE ''
    END as "de_exam_proctoring_status",
    current_timestamp as "dt_load_utc",
    NULL as "dt_processed_utc"
FROM
(SELECT portf.portfolio_id as "portfolio_id",
             portf.person_id as "person_id",
             portf.component_id as "course_id",
             portf.status as "status"
      FROM ods_imc_portfolio portf
	  JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON portf.component_id = course.component_id
	  JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
	  WHERE course.is_template = '0'
	  AND coursetemplate.characteristic_id = '4'
    --AND ((portf.status = '8' AND portf.is_reserved = '0') OR portf.status <> '8')
  	  AND portf.is_reserved = '0'
) book 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_exam.portfolio_id as "exam_booking_id",
           user_exam.person_id as "exam_person_id",
           user_exam.component_id as "exam_id",
           user_exam.course_id as "exam_course_id",
           (SELECT property_value FROM ods_imc_clix_propvalues WHERE property_name = CONCAT('strCourseSubscriptionState_', user_exam.status) AND language_id = '26') as "exam_status",
           user_exam.tracking_count as "tracking_count",
           user_exam.startdate as "startdate",
           user_exam.enddate as "enddate",
           CASE WHEN user_exam.result = '-1.0000' THEN ''
                ELSE user_exam.result
           END as "result",
           user_exam.try_count as "try_count",
           CASE WHEN user_exam.evaluated_score = '0E-7' THEN ''
                ELSE user_exam.evaluated_score
           END as "evaluated_score",
           user_exam.failed as "failed_count",
           qti.object_id as "exam_object_id"
    FROM ods_imc_portfolio user_exam
    JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON user_exam.course_id = course.component_id
    JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
    LEFT JOIN ods_imc_t_qti_content qti on user_exam.component_id = qti.content_id
    JOIN (select * from  ods_imc_t_qti_contenttype where contenttype_id in ('2','9') ) qtit  on qti.contenttype_id = qtit.contenttype_id) user_exam on book.course_id = user_exam.exam_course_id and book.person_id = user_exam.exam_person_id
left JOIN (SELECT user_exam_attempt.learning_log_id as "exam_booking_attempt_id",
                  user_exam_attempt.person_id as "exam_person_id",
                  user_exam_attempt.component_id as "exam_id",
                  user_exam_attempt.course_id as "exam_course_id",
                  (SELECT property_value FROM ods_imc_clix_propvalues WHERE property_name = CONCAT('strCourseSubscriptionState_', user_exam_attempt.result_state) AND language_id = '26') as "exam_status",
                  user_exam_attempt.tracking_count as "tracking_count",
                  user_exam_attempt.start_date as "startdate",
                  user_exam_attempt.end_date as "enddate",
                  CASE WHEN user_exam_attempt.result = '-1.0000' THEN ''
                       ELSE user_exam_attempt.result
                  END as "result",
                  user_exam_attempt.try_count as "try_count",
                  CASE WHEN user_exam_attempt.evaluated_score = '0E-7' THEN ''
                       ELSE user_exam_attempt.evaluated_score
                  END as "evaluated_score",
                  user_exam_attempt.failed as "failed_count",
                  qti.object_id as "exam_object_id",
                --   user_exam_attempt
                  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                      PARTITION BY user_exam_attempt.course_id, qti.content_id, user_exam_attempt.person_id, user_exam_attempt.try_count
                      ORDER BY CAST(user_exam_attempt.learning_log_id AS BIGINT) DESC
                  ) AS rn
            FROM ods_imc_learning_log user_exam_attempt
      	    JOIN ods_imc_e_component course ON user_exam_attempt.course_id = course.component_id
	        JOIN ods_imc_e_componenttype coursetemplate ON course.type_id = coursetemplate.componenttype_id
	        LEFT JOIN ods_imc_t_qti_content qti on user_exam_attempt.component_id = qti.content_id
	        JOIN (select * from  ods_imc_t_qti_contenttype where contenttype_id in ('2','9') ) qtit  on qti.contenttype_id = qtit.contenttype_id 
	        WHERE user_exam_attempt.try_count <> '0'
	        ) user_exam_attempt on user_exam_attempt.exam_course_id = user_exam.exam_course_id and user_exam_attempt.exam_person_id = user_exam.exam_person_id and user_exam_attempt.exam_id = user_exam.exam_id
left join ods_imc_e_composing course_exam on course_exam.composing_id = user_exam.exam_course_id and course_exam.component_id = user_exam.exam_id
left join ods_imc_meazure_learning_session exam_booking on exam_booking.course_id = book.course_id and exam_booking.person_id = book.person_id and exam_booking.test_id = user_exam.exam_id
left join ods_imc_person per on per.person_id = user_exam.exam_person_id
left join ods_imc_timezone tmz on tmz.timezone_id = per.timezone_id
where (user_exam_attempt.rn = 1 OR user_exam_attempt.rn IS NULL)

This is used to flag if this dimension record is the one to use for the day(s).   We want to use the records that cover the close/end of a day.      Where the range spans days then the flag will refer to all the days from the 'valid from' date to the  'valid end' date - 1.
Example:
Record 1 : valid from 06 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 09:00    
will flag this is the day record for 06 07 2026     is_day_record - true

Record 2: valid from 07 07 2026 9:00   valid to 07 07 2026 12:30
this will not be flagged as a day record.            is_day_record - false

Record3 : valid from 07 07 2026 12:30   valid to 09 07 2026 12:30    
will flag this is the day record for  07 07 2026  and 08 07 2026     is_day_record - true   

Discussed possible process:
is_day_record = (date(valid_to) > date(valid_from)) OR (valid_from = the latest valid_from for that key)

loading logic

  
Get the latest loaded but not processed records from st_imc_skill

For every record in the staging table that has not been processed
do 
   Compare each record to the latest matching (where is_current = true ) cd_skill_id in the dim_skill table.     
   if there is a record
    then
        if any of the following columns are different 
( type 2 )
          de_scale
          is_active
          ni_days_to_expire
        then  
            create a new dim record in this [dim table]   
            with a unique dim id (pk) and 
            set the 'dt_valid_from' to current date time
            set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'  
            set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
            update existing current record  
                  set 'is_current' to 'false'
                  update the 'dt_valid_to' to  current date.    
        else
(All the other columns are type 1) 
           update any other columns that are different in the current active dim record.

      'dt_valid_from' to current data time  and
      set the 'dt_valid_to' to 'NULL'     and
      set 'is_current'  to 'true'    
    end

   for staging records processed

End  -- of for
